meta.title: Counter Offer Banner shown to the vendor on receipt of a counter offer
warnings: dropped place_bid — the case switches to the vendor's side to look, and never says the vendor bids

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Configure the event as an RFQ so the counter-offer flow is available.
Move to the RFQ pricing stage.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add a product for the vendor quote sheet.
Invite the QA vendor who will receive the counter offer.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Confirm the vendor quote was accepted.
Return to the buyer console to send the counter offer.
Open the buyer comparison grid containing the vendor bid.
Send a counter offer to the bidding vendor.
Confirm the buyer grid records the pending counter offer.
Open the vendor's separate supplier-portal session.
Open the RFQ pricing sheet where the counter-offer banner should appear.
Assert that the vendor sees the Counter Offer banner or its visible pending-counter-offer label above the quote sheet.
